title: Source inventory runtime layer
summary: This iteration projects daily logical-source runtime status onto the full 154-row collection-entry inventory, so mapped rows show inherited source status, mapped-but-missing rows show unreported, and unmapped rows show collection_only without changing fixed source order.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory rows expose runtime status layer" tests/unit.test.js
node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory|source-first runtime|source metrics dashboard|source-first IA" tests/unit.test.js

degraded_sections.message: The real 2026-06-29 page-check still reports the existing community_cards_reader_facing degraded check, but no blocking checks are present and this iteration does not modify community card rendering.

lessons.lesson: Static collection-entry visibility does not answer whether a source had a daily runtime state.
lessons.evidence: The red unit test failed because inventory rows only showed logical-source mapping and static metadata; the red E2E showed source_first_public_contract still passed after runtime status was absent.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep per-row runtime projection and page-check counts whenever the source inventory remains public.

lessons.lesson: Collection-only entries need an explicit public label instead of pretending to have per-entry runtime health.
lessons.evidence: The real 2026-06-29 page-check reports 81 collection_only rows, 25 unreported rows, and 48 inherited runtime rows inside the 154-row inventory.
lessons.recommended_action: Continue using logical source rows as the authoritative daily runtime layer unless the data model is expanded to collect per-entry health.

lessons.lesson: Generated order references and public daily pages now have different runtime surfaces.
lessons.evidence: The handbook and source inventory order reference now state that the reference is static while public daily pages additionally project runtime status.
lessons.recommended_action: Do not use runtime status to reorder docs/source-inventory-order.md; use it only in daily public rendering and page-check diagnostics.

followups.action: Continue the source-first roadmap by refining the first-screen story and metrics dashboard using the now-visible runtime inventory layer.
